headline.title: Distribution capacity is setting the pace
headline.text: The largest distributors are adding hubs, stores and automation at once, while loyalty programmes and rebuilt online stores show where the digital race is heading.

themes.description: New or expanded distribution centers, hubs and store networks to improve availability.
Distributors entering new towns, states or dealer networks.
Online stores, loyalty programmes and digital catalogs for workshops and consumers.
Events, training and programmes that deepen relationships with repair shops.

stories.title: opens 63 net new stores in the third quarter, reaching 6,758 locations
stories.summary: O'Reilly reported 63 net new stores in Q3 (54 in the US, 8 in Mexico, 1 in Canada) and 173 year to date, with no closures. It remains on track for 225–235 openings in 2026 and credits new-store performance and double-digit professional growth for its share gains.

stories.title: opens its first store in Richboro, Pennsylvania
stories.summary: Advance is opening a store on 2nd Street Pike in Richboro, Bucks County, its first in the town, with a ribbon cutting on 29 October. The opening includes a $1,000 donation to a local automotive technician programme.

stories.title: automates its flow-center fulfilment with a goods-to-person storage and retrieval system
stories.summary: Genuine Parts' NAPA has engaged Hy-Tek Intralogistics to deploy a Hai Robotics HaiPick system as part of a transformation of its flow-center operations. The system is meant to raise storage density, throughput and order accuracy and to scale with NAPA's growth.

stories.title: signs McDonald Automotive as its 29th dealer-group franchise, covering the Denver metro area
stories.summary: Mighty announced a franchise agreement with McDonald Automotive, a 13-dealership group in the Denver area, which will operate as McDonald Mighty from warehouse space at its Audi dealership in Parker, Colorado. Parts distribution comes in-house for the dealer group.

stories.title: expands its VIP Event Series to a two-day format in Houston, Dallas and Orlando
stories.summary: The 2026 series combined product training, supplier showcases, awards and customer trade shows for independent repair shops. Houston and Orlando moved to a two-day format, and Orlando marked the company's return to that market for the series.

stories.title: launches CarParts+ Rewards, its first points-based loyalty programme
stories.summary: Customers earn points on every dollar across a catalogue of more than 1.5 million parts, with a free tier and a $79-a-year Gold tier that bundles roadside assistance, free shipping and extended returns. Since a soft launch in September the programme has enrolled over 118,000 members.

stories.title: completes its US distribution-center buildout and targets 300 mega hubs within three years
stories.summary: On its fiscal Q4 call AutoZone said the US distribution expansion is complete, with two new distribution centers and two direct-import facilities. It opened 39 mega hubs in the year to reach 172, plans more than 40 in fiscal 2027, and keeps roughly $1.5 billion of annual capital on stores, hubs and mega hubs.

stories.title: opens three stores in Georgia, Massachusetts and Maryland, with the Athens site doubling as a market hub
stories.summary: Advance opened a fifth Athens, Georgia store that also operates as a market hub for same-day fulfilment to nearby stores, plus second stores in Randolph, Massachusetts and Lanham, Maryland. Each opening included a donation to a local automotive technology programme.

stories.title: relaunches its e-commerce site covering 1.8 million parts and 300 million vehicle applications
stories.summary: JEGS went live with a rebuilt digital commerce platform on PhaseZero, replacing a system that had run for more than two decades. It adds fitment-based search, live pricing and inventory, delivery estimates and more than 20 integrations, with AI-assisted commerce planned next.

stories.title: opens a 450,000 sq ft distribution center in Olive Branch, Mississippi, its first in the state
stories.summary: The Lake Success, New York distributor opened the hub near Memphis in a major logistics corridor, fully staffed from day one. It is meant to speed deliveries to commercial customers and repair shops nationwide and to broaden inventory across the network.

host_note.name: Julieta Vázquez
host_note.text: More part numbers do not automatically create more sales. The opportunity is knowing which applications have demand, where coverage gaps exist and how much inventory each category really needs. When that intelligence is connected to engineering and production, assortment becomes a growth tool.

offers.name: Optimize Your Sourcing and Inventory
offers.title: Improve availability while reducing capital tied up in slow-moving inventory
offers.claim: Reduce lost sales from stockouts and capital tied up in slow-moving part numbers. We combine demand intelligence with integrated production and regional supply to align inventory and sourcing with the applications your business needs.
points: Demand-based coverage. Inventory priorities based on applications and sales patterns.
Integrated production. Coordination of materials and manufacturing with your operational requirements.
Regional sourcing. Supply options from Mexico and the U.S. based on your SKU mix and order volumes.
Product reliability. Engineering and manufacturing controls reduce product-related returns.
offers.body: Intelligence & Supply Under Control. Our demand data guide inventory decisions. Integrated production, the validation laboratory and the Mexico–U.S. platform connect those decisions with products and supply. We work with you to balance coverage, reliability and inventory investment.

offers.name: Improve Your Product Mix & Category Profitability
offers.title: Maximize productivity per part number and return on investment
offers.claim: Improve category margin and profit contribution with an assortment aligned with market demand. Through our PARTNER program, we turn market and business information into ongoing decisions on coverage, inventory turnover and sales opportunities.
points: Category assessment. Joint analysis of demand, coverage, sales and inventory.
Assortment opportunities. Select applications based on inventory turnover and sales potential.
Assortment transition. Part number mapping and phased changes to support continuity.
Ongoing adjustments. Monitoring of sales, coverage and inventory through PARTNER.
offers.body: Category Management Through PARTNER. We integrate demand intelligence with your business's sales and inventory data. Our specialists support category assessment, assortment design, transition and ongoing adjustments. We turn information into decisions about which part numbers to add, retain or adjust.

offers.name: Win, Grow & Retain Customers
offers.title: Serve more repair needs and build customer loyalty
offers.claim: Win new customers and support more repair needs with a broader assortment of relevant, reliable parts. We combine demand insights, application development and manufacturing control so your professional and DIY customers can find the best solution for their needs.
points: Relevant assortment. Applications selected using vehicle population intelligence and demand data for your region.
More sales opportunities. Development of part numbers for newer applications and unmet repair needs.
Fit & performance. Specialized mount engineering for fit and vibration control.
Quality from the source. Control over rubber, formulation and manufacturing to support reliable repairs.
Technical expertise. Specialist support for the correct selection, installation and use of each part.
offers.body: Intelligence Applied to Every Repair. Our vehicle population and application data guide product development. Our engineering team, rubber laboratory and integrated production turn that knowledge into specialized solutions for your assortment. We combine relevant coverage with manufacturing control to give your customers more reasons to buy and return.

offers.name: Broaden Your Assortment & Business Lines
offers.title: Turn more repair needs into sales
offers.claim: Expand your offering with new applications and high-demand repair solutions. We integrate demand insights, engineering and flexible manufacturing to identify coverage gaps and develop products with commercial potential.
points: Coverage gaps. Identification of missing applications with commercial potential.
Flexible production. Rubber, aluminum and steel processing to develop and scale part numbers.
Products to specification. Designs and material formulations tailored to application requirements.
Repair kits. Group related components to support complete repairs and additional sales.
offers.body: Engineering and Manufacturing to Expand Your Offering. Our technical team combines application intelligence, laboratory resources and rubber, aluminum and steel capabilities. We develop and validate solutions to specification to bring new part numbers to your category. We work with you to turn repair needs into a differentiated market offering.

offers.name: Expand Your Channels & Markets
offers.title: Create more opportunities with the right assortment
offers.claim: Grow across existing channels and enter new markets with an assortment aligned with regional demand. Our geographic and application intelligence is combined with production in Mexico (USMCA) and U.S. logistics to support your expansion.
points: Regional opportunities. Identification of demand by geography, vehicle make and application.
Tailored assortment. Coverage aligned with the vehicle population in each market.
Regional availability. Production in Mexico, with inventory and distribution in the U.S.
Focused expansion. Prioritize applications that match the needs of customers in each channel.
offers.body: Specialization by Region & Application. Our demand and vehicle population data help tailor your assortment to each region. Manufacturing in Mexico and U.S. distribution support timely delivery to your stores. The digital catalog, EDI integration and ACES/PIES facilitate connections with your channels and systems.

offers.name: Co-Develop Solutions and Products
offers.title: Be first to meet unserved repair needs
offers.claim: We work with you to develop differentiated products for applications with unmet demand. Market intelligence, specialized engineering and manufacturing to your specifications help move projects from opportunity to design and launch.
points: Unmet opportunities. Identification of applications with demand and gaps in supply.
Joint design. Engineering and material formulations tailored to your project and target markets.
Technical validation. Materials and performance testing during development.
Flexible scaling. Coordination of engineering and manufacturing to industrialize new solutions.
offers.body: Specialized Development Around Your Business. Application intelligence, engineering, precision equipment and technical laboratories support co-development. Manufacturing to specification connects design with industrialization. Our investment capacity and willingness to invest enable product and infrastructure projects aligned with your growth strategy.

offers.name: Secure Sustainable and Responsible Supply
offers.title: Gain visibility into material origins & production processes
offers.claim: Align your supply with your business's responsibility and traceability requirements. Our control over rubber, formulation and manufacturing provides a practical basis for understanding materials and processes and defining the documentation your organization needs.
points: Own natural rubber production. Control over a key input for part performance.
Integrated formulation. Composition and processing tailored to the application.
Manufacturing visibility. Control over materials and processes to establish evidence of origin.
Regional operations. Coordination of production in Mexico and distribution from the U.S.
offers.body: Control & Traceability of Materials and Processes. Our own rubber production, formulation expertise, and processing and manufacturing facilities let us manage a core input in our products and track its transformation. Vertical integration enables us to work with your supply chain and quality teams to establish traceability requirements and documentation for materials and processes.
